Package index

App

run_app()
Run the Eurostat Indicators Explorer

Data

The catalogue of indicators and countries, downloading an indicator from Eurostat for the countries or the regions, or the population of a country by age and sex, checking the catalogue against Eurostat, and the values of all the indicators that the Change (%) tab compares; the values of an indicator of the countries or the regions, or the population of a country by age and sex, as saved in the package, without internet, which the examples of the charts use

all_values()
The values of all the indicators
check_indicators()
Check the catalogue against Eurostat
countries()
The countries of the app
get_indicator()
Get an indicator for the countries
get_pyramid()
Get the population of a country by age group and sex
get_regional()
Get an indicator for the regions
indicator_change()
Indicators that rose or fell between two years for one country
indicators()
The indicators of the app
saved_indicator()
Get an indicator for the countries, as saved in the package
saved_pyramid()
Get the population of a country by age group and sex, as saved in the package
saved_regional()
Get an indicator for the regions, as saved in the package

Plot

The plotly charts of the tabs: country and indicator comparisons, population pyramid, ranked bars, maps of the countries and of the regions, scatter plot

plot_bar()
Ranked bars of an indicator, animated by year
plot_country_comp()
Line chart of an indicator for several countries
plot_indicator_comp()
Line chart of several indicators for one country
plot_map()
Map of the countries, animated by year
plot_pyramid()
Population pyramid, animated by year
plot_regions()
Map of the regions, animated by year
plot_scatter()
Scatter plot of two indicators, animated by year

Render

The tables of the Change (%) and Indicators tabs

render_change_table()
One table of indicator_change() as a DataTable
render_index_table()
Table of the indicators
